notes.title: Happy International Cat Day
notes.notes:
[p]Today is celebrated the Internacional Cat Day, a special day created in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare. [/p][p]
It's a date to raise awareness about the importance of adoption and welfare animal.
[/p][p]And to make this day even more purrr fect, we created a super special promotion this week, with 30% off on our games![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]=^.^=[/p]

notes.title: One year anniversary! Special Promotion and Update nº 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! :)

This month, Cats Everywhere is celebrating its 1st anniversary since launch. 

And to celebrate, we’ve released this anniversary update!

In this update, we added:
- Tips for finding special objects
- Special animations
- Translations for 2 more languages: French and German
- Windowed mode


Thanks for all your support throughout this year. We really appreciate it!


=^.^=
